defects.title: With no report in context, step-4 ('Place numbered citations in the report') invents a new topic and returns an unrelated report instead of saying there is no prior report to cite.
defects.expected_behavior: Say that there is no prior report to cite, or ask for one, rather than produce an off-topic fabricated report.
defects.observed_behavior: All 7 earlier rounds (948329b3dd45, zhipu) were invalid with 429 at step-4. New source cfa7364189aa: both rounds reached step-4 cleanly and, with no report in context, invented a new topic (Wikipedia's own citation/verifiability policies) and wrote an off-task report instead of saying no prior report exists. Unlike the original 'Quantum Computing' report, the new reports cite Wikipedia pages that were really fetched, so only the topic-substitution half reproduced; R2 step-2 also cited non-Wikipedia (Semantic Scholar/arXiv) items. Reproduction: 2 of 2 valid rounds on this source (cfa7364189aa).
